rationale: Schema rename. The checkout stock gate reads SQL inventory: inventory->store_inventory, available_today->available_today_quantity, sku->product_sku, basket line quantity->requested_quantity. Verbatim /docs/checkout.md gate quotes (which still say 'quantity'/'available_today' because the doc was not renamed) were preserved, with a schema note mapping the doc's conceptual fields to current SQL columns. Dependency table names renamed.

dependencies.why: Gate set, source order, and Store Desk Checkout Vocabulary anti-patterns; the verbatim line-eligibility quote.
Identity gate applied via identity_and_auth before the stock check.
Ownership (customer_id), basket_status, store pointer, and canonical basket shape.
Basket line requested_quantity when queried directly.
available_today_quantity and missing-row checkout gates, keyed by (store_id, product_sku).

rollback.strategy: Restore bp_checkout v0003 content and old sql_table dependencies (baskets, basket_lines, inventory) if the rename mapping proves wrong.
